# algizian Provider

Manage Algizian (OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect with social logins): tenants, custom domains, OIDC clients, own provider apps, email sign-in and service accounts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    algizian = {
      source = "elmerisllc/algizian"
    }
  }
}

# The token comes from ALGIZIAN_TOKEN. An org admin token or a service-account
# credential names its organization, so `org` is only needed with a platform token.
provider "algizian" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Management API base URL. Default `https://id.algizian.com/api/v1`; environment variable `ALGIZIAN_ENDPOINT`.
- `org` (String) Default organization slug for tenants and service accounts. A token that belongs to an organization is enough; set this with a platform token. Environment variable `ALGIZIAN_ORG`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token (`ag_...`): a platform token, an org admin token, a service-account credential or a tenant `manage` token. Environment variable `ALGIZIAN_TOKEN`.
